data.one_liner: Dart native HTML tree navigation, searching, and modification library inspired by Python's BeautifulSoup.
data.what_it_does: Parses HTML documents and fragments into a tree structure. Provides methods to navigate, search via tags, attributes, and custom CSS selectors, and modify the HTML tree.
use_when: You need to parse, search, and navigate HTML trees in Dart.
You want an API inspired by Python's BeautifulSoup library.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete web browser engine or heavy web scraping framework.
strengths: Easy navigation and searching of HTML elements.
Supports modifying the HTML tree and attributes.
weaknesses: Limited to HTML parsing and tree manipulation.
Some methods from BeautifulSoup are not yet implemented.

alternatives.name: xml
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to parse and process XML data structures instead of HTML.
